'''Firazene''' was a type of chemical that could neutralize [[Trivoris]], a lethal nerve gas. [[Harron Tavus]] purchased a shipment of Trivoris from the criminal syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], but [[Havoc Squad]] located and neutralized the gas with firazene.
